title: Network Marketing Recruiting: How I Recruited 10 People in 10 Days
summary: An MLM leader's five recruiting tips: treat recruiting as a process, don't prejudge, play the numbers, follow up fast and work with the willing.

assertions.quote: if you want to have Financial Freedom and time freedom in network marketing recruiting is essential
we can make up in numbers what we lacked in skill

verdicts.note: More contacts do mechanically yield more yeses, but conversion rates and saturated personal networks cap it, and in MLMs more recruits rarely means profit.

assertions.quote: knowing that it takes five to eight exposures remember we talked about recruiting as a process it's not an event

verdicts.note: Multi-touch follow-up is standard sales practice, but the specific exposure count is folklore and persistence does not make an MLM opportunity profitable.

assertions.quote: you're going to find that it starts to compound and and it grows even faster it's like a snowball
your numbers will get better over a period of time
